name: OFAC · Venezuela sanctions
description: The official programme page brings together Venezuela-related sanctions material, general licences, guidance, and recent actions.
use: Record the exact document, version, effective date, parties, activity, and expiry provisions relevant to the research question.
limit: A programme summary does not establish that a particular transaction is authorised. Refer transaction-specific interpretation to qualified counsel.

name: EIA · Venezuela country analysis
description: Country analysis covering petroleum, natural gas, electricity, infrastructure, and trade. Figures in this edition refer to different historical periods.
use: Build the structural energy context, then record the observation year for each figure used in a briefing.
limit: Historical production, reserves, and infrastructure descriptions are not evidence of a facility's current operating condition.

name: ICSID · Registered cases
publisher: International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes
description: A starting point for registered ICSID cases and the public case record.
use: Identify the case number, parties, procedural milestones, and documents available for a defined dispute.
limit: A registered proceeding is not proof of the merits of a claim, collection prospects, or an enforceable recovery value. Some documents may not be public.

name: SEC · EDGAR filings
description: Public access to company filings, with company and full-text search tools.
use: Look for issuer disclosures, risk factors, material agreements, and dated descriptions of legal proceedings. Save the filing and exhibit identifiers.
limit: A filing records what the filer disclosed. Coverage is limited to the relevant filers and documents; it does not independently verify every underlying assertion.

name: EIA · World oil transit chokepoints
description: Analysis of major maritime energy routes, transit volumes, and geographic constraints.
use: Establish route significance and possible alternatives before framing a maritime disruption question.
limit: Transit estimates have reporting periods. Route-level flows do not establish the status of an individual cargo or vessel.

name: EUR-Lex · EU law
publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
description: The European Union's portal for legal documents and the Official Journal.
use: Find the original act and subsequent amendments. Record the document identifier and distinguish publication, entry into force, and application dates.
limit: The relevant instrument and jurisdiction must be identified. A policy announcement and an applicable legal obligation are different research objects.
